Widgets: a guide

Widgets turn gears into motion. This guide shows how to set one up, step by step, and what each part of it does once it is running.

Installing

Install the package, then check that it works:

  1. Download it from the widget site.
  2. Unpack it.
  3. Run the installer.
widget install --all
widget check
